summary: As Florida State Rep from Jacksonville, Nixon introduced a cease-fire resolution in the Florida House; she was the lone lawmaker to mention Palestinian deaths and was called anti-Semite and evil.
quote: Angie Nixon, a Democratic state representative from Jacksonville, speaks with reporters after the House overwhelmingly rejected her resolution advocating for de-escalation and a cease-fire in Israel and Gaza.

summary: Defending her cease-fire resolution in the Florida House, Nixon told colleagues who turned their backs: 'I am on the right side of history because I don't want the babies to die.'
quote: And you can turn your backs on me, but I am on the right side of history because I don't want the babies to die," Nixon told them.

summary: Nixon's HR 31C called for 'immediate de-escalation and cease-fire in Israel and occupied Palestine,' citing 1,400 Israelis and 10,000+ Palestinians killed; defeated 104-2.
quote: I filed this resolution for the 1,400 Israelis and now over 10,000 Palestinians killed since the attack. Sadly, my resolution was the only one that recognized explicitly the Palestinian people that have also suffered.

summary: On the Florida House floor, Nixon noted Israel had killed 10,000 Palestinians and asked 'How many will be enough?' while defending her cease-fire resolution.
quote: Defending the resolution on the floor, she noted that Israel had already killed 10,000 Palestinians, and asked, "How many will be enough?"

summary: Introduced FL House resolution for Gaza ceasefire and hostage release (failed 104-2); during debate asked 'how many [dead Palestinians] will be enough?'
quote: During debate on a resolution introduced by state Rep. Angie Nixon calling for a ceasefire in Gaza and the release of hostages, she posed the question, 'We are at 10,000 dead Palestinians, how many will be enough?'

summary: In X post during Senate primary, stated she is not receiving AIPAC funding, contrasting herself with establishment-backed candidates.
quote: I am not receiving AIPAC funding.

summary: Stated opposition to sending Israel any money or weapons; platform calls for ceasefire, ending settlement support, and human-rights conditions on aid.
quote: In an August 2026 interview, she said she did not support sending Israel 'any money or any weapons' at that moment.
